title: 31st October – Diwali Fellowship
summary: The much awaited Diwali Party with Taash, Mahjong & Funfair was held on Saturday, 31st October 2026 at Banquet Hall, Rustomjee Crown, Prabhadevi.
description:
The much awaited Diwali Party with Taash, Mahjong & Funfair was held on Saturday, 31st October 2026 at Banquet Hall, Rustomjee Crown, Prabhadevi. Good food, great company, a little friendly competition and lots of laughter.
A special shout of appreciation goes for our superb Rtn Manoj Yadav for sponsoring the drinks for our Diwali Party.
Also a big thank you to Rtn Partner Sonal Anand Agarwal, Rtn Partner Namita Malhotra, Rtn Brijendra Kagzi and Rtn Ashish Jalan
Lovely Diwali Get-together. Super fun catching up with everyone. Enjoyed by one and all and very well organised
A heartfelt thank you to President Rtn Naresh Gupta, Rajesh Choudhary, Deepak Malhotra, Ashish Jalan and the entire Rotary team for orchestrating such a delightful and memorable evening. Their warmth, hospitality, and impeccable arrangements truly made the celebration sparkle.
Present 40 Members and 35 Partners
